summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Janus Henderson Equity Linked Moderate Income ETF (JELM) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in income alternatives. The fund is an actively managed structured income strategy that uses derivatives to replicate the payout structure of autocallable and equity-linked notes. The laddered exposure may range across single stock, single index, and index baskets. JELM was launched on Apr 21, 2026 and is issued by Janus Henderson.
